title: Fire, the Zodia, the Body, and the Many Names of the Soul-Garments
summary: Cosmic correspondences focusing on fire, body, and naming: the Five Works of Fire as the cosmic signature of love operating in the mingled cosmos; the Twelve Zodia bound in the sphere as the proprium articulated through every quarter of heaven; the cosmos extensively fashioned as the body of a great man and the body as the field of regeneration; the upward ladder of gathering-inward from element to element home to the aeons of the Greatness; the many names of the one garment (Jesus, pearls, icons, Cross of Light, Counsel of Life) as the dispersed Living Soul; and the envy of Hyle that counterfeits the divine likeness in flesh.
organizing_principle: Cosmic correspondences treating fire as love, the zodiacal binding of falsity, the body-cosmos extended, the gathering-inward ladder, and the naming of the dispersed Living Soul — each teaching elaborating one mode by which Divine Truth is held in or released from the natural.
